description: Every valuation satisfying the result of eliminating a finite list of atoms from \(\Gamma\) extends to a valuation satisfying \(\Gamma\) that agrees with it on every atom absent from the list.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.elimination_many_extend.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (ps : List α)
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.ClauseSet α) (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α)
  (h : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Models v (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.eliminateMany ps Γ)) :
  ∃ w, Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Models w Γ ∧ ∀ q ∉ ps, w q = v q
